detail.text: The pinned Mathlib (0df444a3) has only the classical constants: Chebyshev.theta_le_log4_mul_x gives theta(x) <= x log 4 (about 1.386 x), Chebyshev.theta_ge gives theta(n) >= n log 2 - log(n+1) - 2 sqrt(n) log n (about 0.693 n), and Chebyshev.psi_le_const_mul_self gives psi(x) <= (log 4 + 4) x. A prime in (x, 6x/5) needs theta(6x/5) > theta(x); these bounds give at best theta(6x/5) >= 0.832 x against theta(x) <= 1.386 x, so they decide nothing for any x. The ratio of the available constants is 2…
